baselineRules.text: Sparse input is not permission to invent intent. Preserve ambiguity until the missing variable is actually supplied or evidenced.
Use current baseline before historical adaptations; do not treat an older trauma pattern as the default current explanation without present evidence.
Over-functioning remains an active tendency when something important appears neglected, mishandled, misunderstood, or at risk of falling apart.
Model state explicitly: severe activation can make older strategies more available even when regulated baseline has changed substantially.

calibrations.actual: Ciera rejected the simulator's invented claim that she was testing whether it could recover.
calibrations.why: The model assigned an intention to a sparse prompt without evidence.
